title: Extension: context-history
description: A whole conversation's transcript, in one call and optionally windowed (HP-304). `GetTask` returns one TURN; a client opening a chat wants the CONTEXT, which is many turns, and for a long one it wants only the newest slice. Without this extension a client must fall back to HP-201/HP-202 and pull every turn separately at full size. Each $defs entry carries its own examples.

contextId.description: The A2A context — the id the CLIENT minted, never the provider's own internal session id.

limit.description: Window size. ABSENT means the complete transcript, and the provider then MUST omit hasMore/oldestCursor/staleCursor entirely — that absence is what tells the client this response is not windowed. A window may come back LONGER than `limit`: see oldestCursor.

before.description: A `messageId` — the oldest message the client already holds, taken from a previous response's `oldestCursor`. The window returned ends immediately BEFORE it (exclusive), so pages never overlap. Paging is backwards-only; there is no `after` (live turns arrive on the stream instead). Honoured only together with `limit`.

messages.description: Standard A2A Messages, ALWAYS oldest-first, so a client prepends a page exactly as received. An empty array is a legitimate answer for a context that has not spoken yet.

hasMore.description: Older messages exist before this window. Omitted when the request carried no `limit`.

oldestCursor.description: The `messageId` of the window's FIRST message — pass it back as `before` to page older. Null when nothing older remains. Because the window start is snapped back to a real turn boundary (so a window never splits a tool call from its result), the returned window MAY contain more messages than `limit` asked for; `limit` is a floor, not an exact count.

staleCursor.description: The `before` cursor is no longer in the transcript — typically a compaction moved it out from under the client. The provider MUST then answer with empty `messages`, `hasMore: false` and `oldestCursor: null` rather than an error, and the client reloads the context from the newest page. Omitted when false.

truncated.description: Content was dropped to stay under the HP-203 size ceiling. Silent truncation is a violation (HP-203), so this MUST be set whenever anything was cut.
